description: Main Phase OfferService cyclic gap이 cyclic_offer_delay ± tolerance인지 검증 (SOME/IP-SD §4.2.1)
approach:
[검증 목적]
Repetition Phase 후 DUT은 고정 cyclic_offer_delay로 OfferService를 발신하는 Main Phase 진입. cadence가 spec invariant.

[시나리오 — 시간순]
1. DUT이 Main Phase (Repetition Phase 후).
2. 관찰: DUT → 테스터: cyclic OfferService #1 → #2.
3. Δt(#2,#1) ≈ cyclic_offer_delay (허용오차 포함).

[통과 조건]
gap이 cyclic_offer_delay ± tolerance와 일치.

[실패 조건]
• Fail_phase2_no_first_main_offer — 첫 main offer 누락
• Fail_phase3_no_second_main_offer — 두 번째 main offer 누락
• Fail_phase3_cyclic_out_of_tolerance — gap이 범위 밖

verdicts.Pass: Main phase cyclic gap이 cyclic_offer_delay와 일치 — 정상
verdicts.Fail_phase2_no_first_main_offer: listen 윈도우 내 첫 main phase offer 없음
verdicts.Fail_phase3_no_second_main_offer: listen 윈도우 내 두 번째 main phase offer 없음
verdicts.Fail_phase3_cyclic_out_of_tolerance: Cyclic offer gap이 cyclic_offer_delay 허용오차 밖
